note: The ten recommended actions from the 2027 readiness outline, plus setup. 'due' is the default deadline; readiness-setup may shift dates for the organization. 'applies_to' lists segment archetype ids from segment-archetypes.md; an empty list means every archetype.

actions.title: Set up the readiness program: profile, data tiers, schedule
actions.done_when: profile.json saved, data readiness map produced, recurring jobs scheduled and the first weekly brief delivered
actions.protects_against: Running the year on memory instead of a system

actions.title: Run a 2027 downside case by payer
actions.done_when: Base, downside and severe scenarios reviewed by the CFO, with cash runway and the trigger points that move the organization from base to downside

actions.title: List every commercial contract renewing in 2027 with escalator and notice dates
actions.done_when: Every commercial contract has a notice deadline, an escalator and a negotiation-prep start date on the schedule
actions.protects_against: Flat or negative renewals and missed notice windows

actions.title: Re-verify eligibility at every visit and flag expansion adults due for six-month renewal
actions.done_when: Eligibility runs before every visit, expansion adults are flagged, and a weekly coverage-churn worklist exists
actions.protects_against: Retroactive eligibility denials and surprise self-pay

actions.title: Give price estimates, collect at time of service, offer payment plans
actions.done_when: Estimate, collection and payment-plan scripts are live, the financial assistance policy is updated, and the POS collection rate is tracked weekly

actions.title: Help Medicaid patients document work hours and exemptions
actions.owner_role: Patient access or care management lead
actions.done_when: At-risk patients receive outreach, exemption screening is part of intake, and diagnosis documentation supports frailty exemptions where accurate

actions.title: Audit AI-assisted coding before payers do
actions.done_when: E/M distribution by provider compared to baseline and benchmark, probe sample reviewed, findings and corrective actions documented

actions.title: Move eligible imaging, infusion and procedures to office or ASC settings
actions.done_when: Each candidate service has a margin comparison by site and a go or no-go decision with an owner

actions.title: Inventory vendors holding PHI and test downtime and claims backup
actions.done_when: Cash-critical vendors identified, BAAs confirmed, a backup clearinghouse path exists and a downtime tabletop has been run
actions.protects_against: A vendor breach that stops cash

actions.title: Add state notice periods to any 2027 deal timeline and clean up MSO and PC governance
actions.done_when: Every live deal has a state-by-state notice map, a dated filing plan and a governance checklist reviewed by counsel

actions.title: Model provider tax and state-directed payment exposure for 2028
actions.done_when: 2028 to 2032 exposure by program is modeled and built into the 2028 budget

recurring.title: Friday close-out of the action tracker
